items.explanation_en: Alternate the rooks to control successive ranks or files, steadily restricting the enemy king until checkmate.

items.label_en: 1. Drive the King to the Corner
items.explanation_en: Use the rook to cut off ranks and the king to drive the enemy king toward the edge, then coordinate for checkmate.
Drive the defending king away with the rook, bring the white king forward, and stop the pawn.
Separate the black king from its pawn and place the rook in front of the pawn on the g-file.

items.label_en: 3. Use Checks to Reach the Promotion File
items.explanation_en: Use rook checks to occupy the pawn's promotion route while the white king approaches to help stop it.
Advance the king to cut the defender off from the pawn, then use the rook to capture it.
Bring the king into play and place the rook to capture the pawn's promoted queen immediately.
Use the back rank to escape with the king while rook checks gain time to capture the pawn.

items.label_en: 1. Draw with the King on the Promotion Square
items.explanation_en: A rook pawn or bishop pawn may not be enough to win if the defending king occupies the promotion square.

items.label_en: 2. Use the Open h-File to Win
items.explanation_en: Drive the black king away with rook checks along the open h-file, then capture the rook.
The rook blocks the pawn from the sixth rank while the king guards key squares, holding the draw.
Use the king and rook to drive away the checking rook, then cut it off so the pawn can advance.
Black uses the rook pawn and lateral checks to keep the white king away from the promotion square.

items.label_en: 6. Support the Pawn from the E-File
items.explanation_en: The rook supports the pawn from the e-file, enabling the king to drive Black away and promote.
Drive the black king away, promote the pawn, and exchange rooks to win with an extra queen.

items.label_en: 8. Lure the Rook Away from the Pawn
items.explanation_en: Bring the king closer to the h-pawn and use the rook to draw the black rook away from its defense.

items.label_en: 9. Drive Away the Rook and Advance
items.explanation_en: The rook is too close laterally to the white king for a drawing setup; drive it away and advance the f-pawn.

categories.label: 车双兵对车
categories.label_en: Rook and Two Pawns vs. Rook

items.explanation_en: Bring the king closer and use it to support the connected pawns as they advance.
Use the king and rook to support the connected g- and f-pawns, creating an unstoppable promotion threat.
Cut off the black king with the rook while the white king supports the connected pawns.
Coordinate the king and rook to advance the f-pawn and create a decisive promotion threat.
With the king behind the pawns, Black can draw by repeatedly checking from the side with the rook.

items.label_en: 6. Cut Off the King to Draw
items.explanation_en: Use long-range rook checks to cut the white king off from the connected pawns and hold the draw.
